strengths: 99.4% on-time payroll accuracy, modern Euro-6 fleet (<2.5 years average vehicle age), and 91% annual retention among tenured (>2 years) long-haul C-CQC drivers.
cohort: HQ commercial/admin roles (140 staff in Verona) hire smoothly in 24 days via LinkedIn. The acute bottleneck is exclusively on the 120 frontline C-CQC driver and warehouse operator openings across the regional hubs—especially Bologna and Naples—where average Time-to-Hire has reached 43 days.
